notes:
v4.6.15 — Universe-tab dropdown actually picks the script that runs

🐛 FIXED
• When you selected a custom universe script from the Universe tab dropdown and clicked RUN, the frozen exe was running the BUILT-IN universe_manager.py instead — silently ignoring your selection. Root cause: APEX.exe --run-bot UNIVERSE hardcoded 'import universe_manager; um.run_manager(...)'. So your crypto universe bot's output appeared in the log but never wrote crypto_universe.txt (the built-in only writes long/short/day universe files).
• Fix: BotProcessWidget now passes the user-selected script path as a 4th CLI arg when side=UNIVERSE. _run_bot uses runpy to exec that path instead of importing the built-in. Built-in is still the default if no path is passed (legacy behaviour preserved).
• Result: picking your crypto universe bot → clicking RUN → it actually executes long_crypto_universe.py → crypto_universe.txt is written → the crypto card in the Universe tab grid shows the tickers.
